```{r initial brant wald test}
# | echo: false

# performing prop test in R

library(tidyverse)
library(MASS)
library(brant)

r_prepropXY = read_csv('./data/preprop_XY.csv')
r_prepropXY$cap_cat = ordered(r_prepropXY$cap_cat)

r_preprop_model <- polr(
    cap_cat ~ .- cap_cat,
    data = r_prepropXY,
    method = 'logistic',
    control = list(maxit = 100000)
)

result <- brant(r_preprop_model)
brant_df <- as.data.frame(result)
total_prop_result = brant_df[1,]
write.csv(total_prop_result, './data/first_prop_result.csv', row.names = FALSE)
```
